tools.name: list_chat_conversations
tools.title: List Chat Conversations
tools.description: List the chat conversations the current user participates in, including direct messages and space rooms. Returns each conversation's Matrix room id, type ('dm' or 'space'), title, the Meeds space id for a space room and the other participant's username for a direct message. Filter with type and query rather than listing everything: list_chat_conversations(type='dm', query='Morgan') returns the direct message with Morgan only. Use this to find a conversation before reading or summarizing its messages. To send a message to one person, use send_direct_message with their username instead.

type.description: Optional: 'dm' to list direct messages only, 'space' to list space rooms only; omit to list both

query.description: Optional text the conversation title (a space name, or the other participant's name for a direct message) or the other participant's username contains; case and accents are ignored

limit.description: Optional maximum number of conversations to return (e.g. 20)

tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.title: Get Chat Messages
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent messages of one of the current user's chat conversations, in chronological order. Use the conversation id ('roomId') returned by list_chat_conversations. Useful to summarize a conversation or answer questions about what was discussed.

conversation_id.description: Matrix room id of the conversation, as returned by list_chat_conversations

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (1-200, e.g. 50)

tools.name: get_unread_chat_messages
tools.title: Get Unread Chat Messages
tools.description: List the current user's chat conversations that have unread messages, with the unread count and the recent messages of each. Use this to summarize what the user missed across their conversations (a 'catch me up' digest).

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.title: Send Chat Message
tools.description: Send a text message to one of the current user's chat conversations, on the user's behalf. Use the conversation id ('roomId') returned by list_chat_conversations. Returns the created message event id. To message one person, use send_direct_message with their username instead: it needs no conversation id.

conversation_id.description: Matrix room id of the conversation, as returned by list_chat_conversations

tools.name: send_direct_message
tools.title: Send Direct Message
tools.description: Send a text message to a user, on the current user's behalf, in their direct message conversation, which is opened when the two users have none yet. Takes the recipient's username: find it with search_users when the user names someone by their full name. No need to list the conversations first. Returns the created message event id, or why the message was not sent.

tools.name: search_chat_messages
tools.title: Search Chat Messages
tools.description: Full-text search the current user's chat messages by keyword. By default searches across all of the user's conversations; pass conversation_id to restrict the search to a single conversation. Returns each matching message with its text, sender, timestamp and the conversation it belongs to (id and title), most recent first. Use this to find where something was discussed before reading a whole conversation.

query.description: Free-text search term to match against message contents

conversation_id.description: Optional Matrix room id (as returned by list_chat_conversations) to restrict the search to a single conversation; omit to search everywhere
